name: lindel
description: Linearize multi-dimensional numeric arrays with Hilbert and Morton (Z-order) space-filling curves. Use the resulting integer as a Parquet sort key to organize rows for multi-column range queries.

cta.title: Z-Order / Hilbert-Order Your Parquet
cta.description: Install Lindel to encode multi-dimensional values as one sortable integer and explore curve ordering for your Parquet files.

quickStart.title: Encode a multi-dimensional point to one sortable integer
Order rows by the curve — this is the Parquet write-time sort key
quickStart.sql:
-- Sort nonnegative coordinates by their Hilbert key.
-- Use this ORDER BY inside COPY to persist the layout.
SELECT x, y, hilbert_encode([x, y]::UINTEGER[2]) AS hilbert
FROM (VALUES (3, 5), (1, 1), (7, 0), (2, 6), (5, 3), (0, 4)) AS t(x, y)
ORDER BY hilbert;
